verdict.rationale: ROS 2 is a robotics framework, not an item-management tool. The closest match to bulk operations is the launch system, which coordinates and starts multiple nodes together (ros2-docs-6). Node composition (ros2-docs-4) and the ros2 command-line tools (ros2-docs-37) offer a scriptable way to act on many graph entities at once. Missing for 10: any documented batch or bulk-apply operations (e.g., setting parameters or managing lifecycles across many nodes in one command), AI-oriented bulk automation, and hands-on corroboration.
